summary: Displays fixed race message ID 275 through the shared driver-data table. Guarded by the race-active flag dword_7D0308 and the track-condition state flt_7CF3C8; when both allow it, a vtable method at offset 12 on the sound/system pointer dword_5EB10C is called, the shared buffer flt_5EA618 is reset to 10.0f defaults, a driver table record v0 is populated with message ID 275 and placeholder arguments, and that record is inserted into the table.

operations.description: Run the main body only when dword_7D0308 is non-zero and flt_7CF3C8 is not 0.0; otherwise do nothing.
Call the engine-interface method only when the interface pointer dword_5EB10C is non-null.
Invoke the __thiscall vtable method at offset 12 on the dword_5EB10C object (audio/system reset).
Reset the shared driver-data buffer flt_5EA618 to 10.0f defaults via BufferInitWith10fDefaults.
Populate the stack record v0 with message ID 275 and placeholder driver indices and time via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v0, 275, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0).
Insert the populated record v0 into the shared driver-data table at flt_5EA618 via InsertDriverTableEntry.

unresolved: flt_59E440 (0x0059E440) is listed as a referenced global but does not appear in the raw source.
Meaning of message ID 275 and the -1 / -2.0 placeholder arguments depends on DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion.
Identity of the vtable slot method invoked at offset 12 on dword_5EB10C is unresolved.
